## Checklist

<!-- CI runs the build gate and the licence checks. These are the parts it can't see. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] A bug fix has a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Any `docs/` file describing what changed is updated
- [ ] A change a user would notice has a line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] A new or changed key also updates `docs/010-keybindings.md` and the help overlay (`?`)
- [ ] Tried in the app, not just in the tests
